events.title: EyesOpenCTF 7th edition
events.description:
EyesOpenCTF 2026 is a FREE CTF competition organized as part of the 7th edition of EOCON.

This year, the competition goes far beyond a traditional CTF.
You are not simply joining to solve isolated challenges. You are entering The Convergence, a live 48-hour cyber adventure in which reality itself is beginning to fracture.
Across more than 40 challenges and 8 disciplines, teams will investigate corrupted systems, recover hidden Reality Fragments, unlock classified dossiers, expose compromised actors, and gradually reconstruct the truth behind a phenomenon threatening the entire world.

Every flag matters.
Each solved challenge can reveal new intelligence, unlock characters and locations, alter the mission briefing, and move the story forward in real time. The competition platform becomes a living investigation that evolves with the progress of the Operators.

Expect  : 
- web exploitation, 
- digital forensics, 
- reverse engineering, 
- binary exploitation, 
- cryptography, 
- OSINT, 
- AI security, and more—woven into a single coherent mission unlike any previous EyesOpenCTF.

Built for teams from around the world and open to different experience levels, EyesOpenCTF is both a proving ground and an immersive narrative experience where competitors can learn, compete, get noticed, and join a fast-growing international cybersecurity community.

As part of EOCON, the competition also connects participants with experts, researchers, recruiters, entrepreneurs, and emerging talent from Africa and beyond. It is a place where technical ability meets storytelling, where discoveries change the mission, and where tomorrow’s collaborations, careers, and opportunities begin.

Form your team. Enter the Protocol. Recover the Fragments.

Register: https://eyesopensecurity.com/ctf-briefing.html

Direct Form: https://eyesopensecurity.com/?modal=ctf

SPONSORS :
- CyberDefenders (https://cyberdefenders.org)
- JetBrains (https://jetbrains.com)
- Netticket (https://netticket.net)
- ExamBoot (https://examboot.net)

events.title: Crate-CTF 2026
events.description:
Crate-CTF is an annual Capture The Flag (CTF) competition organised by the Swedish Defence Research Agency in collaboration with the Swedish Armed Forces, designed to introduce high school and university students to the field of cybersecurity. This year we return for our seventh CTF, with challenges for all skill levels from beginners to seasoned CTF players. The challenges are categorised into web exploitation, reverse engineering, binary exploitation, cryptography, forensics, OSINT, networking and the all-encompassing "other".

While the event will be conducted in Swedish, international participants are also welcome to join (using translation tools as needed). Communication with challenge authors and administrators can be conducted in English.

events.title: CyberSci Regional Qualifiers 2026-27
events.description:
CyberSci is Canada's national Cyber Security Challenge for university and college students.
- Think you've got an elite team of students? Come and prove it. Our winners will go on to compete against the best in the world.
- Just starting out? This is the best way to learn and rise to the top.
- Annual in-person events since 2016. (Online during Covid.) Over 500 students so far.

Format:
- Modified jeopardy style. Realistic IT environment.
- Regional qualifiers are held in Nov-Dec each year.
- National finals are the following July.
- Winning teams represent Canada at international events in the Fall.

For Regionals (qualifiers):
We do hacking in the morning, interviews in the afternoon, and job offers by supper (for intern/summer/coop jobs).
- Full-time job offers take a few more days.
- Students register their team through their school instructor or computer club. Max 2 teams per school.

For nationals:
Participants will be the winning team from each regional/qualifier
- PLUS one all-juniors (19 and under)
- AND one all-women team (chosen from participants at the Regionals).
Two-day event.

events.title: BlackHat MEA CTF Final 2026
events.description:
Black Hat MEA Capture The Flag (CTF) 2026 ?

The Black Hat MEA Capture The Flag (CTF) is the largest cybersecurity competition in the region and officially the largest Capture The Flag competition in the world, recognized with a Guinness World Record. Organized by the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP) in collaboration with Black Hat MEA, the competition brings together thousands of cybersecurity professionals, researchers, students, and enthusiasts from around the globe.

Powered by the FlagYard platform, the competition follows a Jeopardy-style format, where teams of 3–5 players compete across a range of cybersecurity challenges, including Web Exploitation, PWN, Digital Forensics, Reverse Engineering, Cryptography, and AI Hacking.

Competition Timeline

Registration: June 3 – August 29, 2026

Online Qualifiers: August 29, 2026 | 10:00 AM KSA (GMT+3) | Online

Thousands of participants will compete globally in teams of 3–5 members, with the top 150 teams qualifying for the final stage.

On-site Finals

The top 150 teams will be invited to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia for a 3-day final competition during Black Hat MEA, taking place from December 1–3, 2026.

Register Now:
https://flagyard.com/events/3468f495-a92c-498b-90c2-994dfb99ea0b

Support: blackhatctf@safcsp.org.sa

events.title: Leo's 20th Birthday Bash
events.description:
Hey! You there! Do you like programming? Do you like puzzles? Do you like... money?

Leo's 20th Birthday Bash is a 24-hour online team contest that's competitive-programming-ish, CTF-ish, math-olympiad-ish, and puzzle-hunt-ish, all wrapped into one.

The contest runs on DMOJ, an online judge for competitive programming, and each team shares one DMOJ account to submit from. Teams can have 1 to 10 members (6 to 8 recommended).

Some problems are CTF-ish, but DMOJ itself is not part of the contest, so please do not attack, probe, or abuse it. The people at DMOJ are hosting this for free >.<

This contest has no sponsors, so all the prize money is from yours truly ;)

Make sure you've read all the rules (see the contest page). In particular, interactive generative AI is not allowed, because it is stinky.

See you there!

events.title: JerseyCTF VII
events.description:
Locations:
- Online if unable to attend in-person
- In-Person @ NJIT Campus Center Ballroom, Newark, New Jersey

JerseyCTF is a beginner-friendly Capture the Flag competition that aims to inspire interest in cybersecurity. This competition is hosted by the NJIT Information & Cybersecurity Club, the NJIT Chapter of ACM, and the NJIT SCI program.

It is geared towards students, beginners, and professionals alike. JerseyCTF provides participants with jeopardy-style questions in categories including cryptography, forensics, binary exploitation/reversing, open-source intelligence, and web exploitation.

This CTF is held hybrid - with attendance virtually or in-person on NJIT's campus in Newark, New Jersey, USA.
